lines.text: Bees give each other directions by dancing.
And the whole map hides in one wiggle. Wait for it.
She finds flowers, flies home, and dances in the dark hive.
Dancing straight up means: fly toward the sun.
Tilt it forty degrees right, and the food is forty degrees right of the sun.
lines.caption: Tilt it 40° right, and the food is 40° right of the sun.

lines.text: The payoff: the longer she waggles, the farther the food. About one second means roughly a kilometer.
lines.caption: The payoff: the longer she waggles, the farther the food. About 1 second means roughly 1 km.

lines.text: Karl von Frisch cracked this code and won a Nobel Prize in nineteen seventy-three.
lines.caption: Karl von Frisch cracked this code and won a Nobel Prize in 1973.
